displayDescription: A block is inked and carved into a lit bulb. Telegraph dashes then become carved lines that link stamped nodes into a system.
styleRenderer: SVG (native DOM: clipPath print regions, userSpace hatch pattern, stroke-dash carving)
motionEngine: Motion 14.1.0 pure easing/interpolation helpers (cubicBezier, easeOut, easeInOut, backOut, mix, progress, clamp) bundled locally to woodcut-motion.js via esbuild
GSAP paused timeline (composition time only, registered at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, no music, no sound effects.
limitations: Woodcut/linocut printing is simulated with vector SVG. There is no physical carving, ink transfer or paper deformation.
Block grain, brayer edge and paper flecks are fixed procedural textures (seeded once at build time), not scanned wood or paper.
The cool blue-gray paper and indigo-black ink are a scene-dependent choice from the reviewed moonlit monochrome option. They are not a supplied brand palette.
No preview_recipes were present in STYLE.json, so this refresh demonstrates the source-frame techniques instead of a named recipe.
Motion is used only for deterministic easing math. Its animate() clock is not used, and GSAP owns timeline time.
Blender was not used, by user instruction.
Rendering and browser QA were not run by the agent.
